hints = [
    # ── Safety property ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Not(bool_var("error")),
    word_le("nitems", 4),
    word_le("posn",   4),

    # ── State-machine reachability cuts ───────────────────────────────
    when(state_in("POP1","POP2","POP3"), word_le("nitems", 3)),
    when(state_in("PUSH1","PUSH2"),       word_lt("posn", "nitems")),
    when(state_in("TEST1","TEST2"),       word_ge("posn", 1)),
    when(state_is("TEST2"),               word_le("posn", 3)),
    when(state_in("PUSH1","POP1"),        word_le("posn", 3)),

    # ── Heap order in stable states (IDLE / TEST) ─────────────────────
    when(And(state_in("IDLE","TEST1","TEST2"), word_ge("nitems", 2)), word_le("h[0]", "h[1]")),
    when(And(state_in("IDLE","TEST1","TEST2"), word_ge("nitems", 3)), word_le("h[0]", "h[2]")),
    when(And(state_in("IDLE","TEST1","TEST2"), word_eq("nitems", 4)), word_le("h[1]", "h[3]")),

    # ── POP states cache: h0 was assigned to h[0] on entry to POP1 ────
    when(state_in("POP1","POP2","POP3"), word_eq("h0", "h[0]")),

    # ── PUSH cycle: PUSH1 sets h1 = h[parent(posn)] before PUSH2 ──────
    # parent(1)=0, parent(2)=0, parent(3)=1
    when(And(state_in("PUSH2","POP1"), word_eq("posn", 1)), word_eq("h1", "h[0]")),
    when(And(state_in("PUSH2","POP1"), word_eq("posn", 2)), word_eq("h1", "h[0]")),
    when(And(state_in("PUSH2","POP1"), word_eq("posn", 3)), word_eq("h1", "h[1]")),

    # ── TEST cycle: TEST1 sets h1 = h[parent(posn)] before TEST2 ──────
    when(And(state_is("TEST2"), word_eq("posn", 1)), word_eq("h1", "h[0]")),
    when(And(state_is("TEST2"), word_eq("posn", 2)), word_eq("h1", "h[0]")),
    when(And(state_is("TEST2"), word_eq("posn", 3)), word_eq("h1", "h[1]")),

    # ── Combined with heap order, h[posn] >= h1 in TEST2 (prevents error=1) ──
    when(And(state_is("TEST2"), word_eq("posn", 1)), word_le("h1", "h[1]")),
    when(And(state_is("TEST2"), word_eq("posn", 2)), word_le("h1", "h[2]")),
    when(And(state_is("TEST2"), word_eq("posn", 3)), word_le("h1", "h[3]"))
]
